text:
Aisha: FYI customer ticket: console shows provisional token delta > confirmed after a stream "graft" (connect, disconnect, graft new session) + toolcall retry. Sending sanitized trace.

Tom: what do you mean by graft? new session attached mid-stream?

Aisha: yeah, server disconnected, client reattached using a new session id that we graft onto the existing conversation. sanitized events: 
```
req=cli-zz-101
events=[connect, chunk(90), disconnect, graft_attach(session=s-graft-42), resumed_chunk(60), toolcall(start, attempt=tc-3), truncate_toolcall, retry(toolcall, attempt=tc-3-r1), finalize, close]
provisional=332
confirmed=198
```

Ravi: classic edge: truncated fragment from pre-graft session counts provisional, then the retry on grafted session counts again. Our ledger tombstoning doesn't link across grafts.

Sasha: router currently normalizes session ids on grafts but we drop origin pointers during the compat conversion. We need persistent origin_session metadata that survives grafts and handoffs.

Tom: could we change the reconciler to prefer the earliest origin_session_id for dedupe? e.g., carry a chain: origin -> graft -> current and dedupe by origin+offset.

Ravi: that works but messy for backward compat. Alternative: provisional events include origin_chain: [s-old, s-graft-42] or at least origin_root. Ledger can then collapse charges by root id. Schema change required.

Sasha: small-step plan: add origin_root_id and attempt_id to toolcall events, provisional=true flag, and a reconcile TTL (90-120s). Router shim to preserve origin_root on grafts. I'll PR the shim.

Aisha: console short-term: show a per-route "Delta" column that shows confirmed vs provisional with a small caret: 198 / 332 (△134) and tooltip: "Includes provisional tokens pending finalization (usually <2m)". Helps SREs.

Tom: backend TTL tradeoff again. If TTL too short we refund too often; too long delays real charge. Suggest 90s by default and experiment. Also add smoothing: only emit a refund when delta > X tokens or >Y% to avoid tiny churn.

Ravi: agree on smoothing. We'll add a refund threshold (e.g., 10 tokens or 5%). Also log metrics: provisional_expire_count, provisional_confirm_count, provisional_refund_amount to tune thresholds.

Sasha: note: telemetry pipelines need to accept the new fields; I'll coordinate with eng-telemetry. Router shim landed in canary branch.

ops-bot: canary deploy for router/graft-preserve-origin completed (commit a7d4c3) :white_check_mark:

Aisha: add integration test: graft scenario + truncated toolcall + retry. Assert ledger shows provisional then one of: (a) finalized -> confirmed, or (b) auto-expired -> refund within TTL and refund amount matches provisional minus confirmed.

Tom: add debug log when origin_root missing: origin_root_dropped=true req=... That should make customer repros obvious.

Ravi: I'll author a short RFD for ledger dedupe rules: prefer origin_root+token_range, add smoothing params, TTL config, and metrics to observe.

Sasha: UX mock incoming. I'll include a small timeline view for per-request details with provisional/confirmed swimlanes.

Aisha: TL;DR: handle session grafts by preserving origin_root_id, emit provisional+attempt ids, add TTL=90s + smoothing thresholds, console delta indicator. Follow-ups: Ravi=RFD, Sasha=shim+UX, Tom=tests+logs.

Tom: assigning follow-ups in tracker. Will pick up tests tomorrow.

Aisha: thanks all 44d
